item.title: That time Springfield made national headlines because of a streetcar strike
item.description: In 1916, Springfield streetcar workers went on strike for 252 days to fight for the right to unionize and bargain collectively, facing poor conditions, dangerous speeds, long hours, overcrowding, and low wages, and ultimately resulting in the company recognizing the union and signing a contract.

item.title: Wintry weather chances at times over the next week
item.description: After 5 and a half days of below-freezing temperatures, Springfield experienced warmer weather and sunshine on Wednesday, but another cold shock is expected to hit the region this weekend, with potential for mist, freezing mist, or flurries, and temperatures remaining cold through Groundhog Day.
